description: Modify terms used in drag force calculations.

keywords.name: epschi
keywords.description: If on (the default), the \(\epsilon^{-\chi}\) term in Equation (10) in the “Theory and Background” section is included. This term adjusts the particle drag force to account for the increase in drag at low porosities.

keywords.name: gradp
keywords.description: If on, the \(\nabla P\) term from Equation (16) in the “Theory and Background” section is included. This term adjusts the particle drag force as a result of the pressure gradient. By default, this term is not included.

examples.description: Include the pressure-gradient term in the drag force

verification: Live-verified 2026-11-09 on PFC3D 6.00, 7.00 and 9.8 consoles (syntax grade): epschi and gradp accepted on all three consoles.
